name: 弗里德里希·米歇尔
bio_short: 瑞士医生和生物学家，被誉为“DNA之父”。他在1869年从白细胞的细胞核中分离出了一种富含磷的酸性物质，将其命名为“核素”（`miescher_nuclein_1869`），这就是后来被确认为遗传物质的DNA。
bio_short_en: A Swiss physician and biologist, often called the 'Father of DNA'. In 1869, he isolated a phosphorus-rich acidic substance from the nuclei of white blood cells and named it 'nuclein' (`miescher_nuclein_1869`), which was later identified as DNA, the genetic material.
